verdict.rationale: Bugbot's core function is AI-generated insight on the user's own code. It analyzes every PR diff for bugs, security vulnerabilities and code-quality issues, then leaves inline comments with explanations and suggested fixes, using prior PR comments as context. Independent users report it finds genuine bugs other reviewers miss, though one hands-on report describes it flip-flopping on a recommended fix. missing for 10: aggregate insight surfaces beyond per-PR comments (Teams 'analytics and reporting' is only a single-line mention), consistent suggestion stability in hands-on use.
